column1: # Conformance rows for an adapter of the stores of ecd, from specs/ecd_stores/ecd_stores.contract.md#conformance (class, open, feed and handoff
# rows) with the SQLite owner's specifics from ecd_stores.design.md (#state-schema, #durability). Outcome vectors are in outcomes.tsv.
# Every adapter in every runtime passes every row whose status is required. Columns are separated by one tab; "-" stands for an absent value.
#   class      the durability class the row applies to: D0 | D1 | D2 | D3, or "any"
#   procedure  a short phrase: what the harness does
#   status     required, or "deferred: REASON" for a row kept but not yet run
#   source     the contract or design line the row comes from

column3: procedure
column4: want

column3: open a store declared D1; read PRAGMA synchronous back
column4: NORMAL (1); the store serves
column6: contract.md:91 durability 3; design.md:500; contract.md:175 class rows

column3: open a store declared D2; read PRAGMA synchronous back (and fullfsync on darwin)
column4: FULL (2); the store serves

column3: declare D2 and open with synchronous=NORMAL
column4: open refuses to serve; no request is answered

column3: open a store; read its identity and its health
column4: both report the declared class, never a higher one

column3: write and get an acknowledgement; kill -9 the process; reopen
column4: the acknowledged write is read back

column3: write with the sync injected to fail
column4: no acknowledgement is sent before the sync; the outcome is not committed

column3: write and get an acknowledgement; delete the volume; restore
column4: the acknowledged write is read back
column5: deferred: no D3 adapter in the SQLite rung

column3: open a path that does not exist
column4: open refuses ("unable to open database file" for SQLite mode=rw); no file appears at the path

column3: open a store whose schema version is below the adapter's
column4: open refuses or serves the old schema; no table or column is added; migrate is a separate call

column3: create with a fault before the rename
column4: no store exists under the final name

column3: open the same store while a first writer holds it
column4: the second open is refused; the first keeps serving

column3: kill -9 after N acknowledged writes; reopen; read the recovery report
column4: the report gives _store.seq, the WAL's length at open and the reopen count

column3: kill -9 during a commit; reopen
column4: a torn unacknowledged tail is discarded; the report says so; no acknowledged write is lost

column3: reopen a shipped store whose local seq is below the shipped one
column4: the report says acknowledged history is missing; admissions stop until restore
column5: deferred: no shipped store in the SQLite rung

column3: run 10,000 write transactions; read every feed row's seq
column4: seq runs from the start position by one with no gap, and equals _store.seq at the end

column3: write inside a transaction that rolls back
column4: no feed row exists for it; seq did not move

column3: delete rows below seq S; read from a cursor (store_id, lineage, seq) with seq < S
column4: the answer is a gap; nothing is skipped silently

column3: read from a cursor whose lineage differs from the store's
column4: gap, cause lineage; the reader restarts from the start of this history

column3: close a store in runtime A; open in runtime B; write; close; reopen in A
column4: each open succeeds, each write is read back, seq has no gap

column3: force each landing of io_commit_readback and full_open (commit landed, commit not landed)
column4: each case reads back exactly rev=1 or absent as forced, not either
column5: deferred: loose until a harness forces each landing

column3: write with a receipt (scope, token); retry after a lost reply
column4: the retry answers the original outcome
column5: deferred: the receipt table arrives by migrate, not in this rung
